call_points.text: New Q2FY27 wins include 1,082 MWp, 210 MWp and 291 MWp ground-mounted solar projects and 280 MWh BESS EPC.
It acquired a 55% stake in APSPL, which has 108,000 MTPA lattice-tower capacity and 100,000 MTPA under construction.
No formal FY27 guidance; management aims to hold consolidated EBITDA margin around 15%.
Unexecuted order book ₹5,300 Cr including T&D, to be executed over 12–15 months.
Chasing 27 GW domestic and 10 GW international solar EPC pipeline.
T&D order pipeline of ₹20,000 Cr actively being pursued.
O&M portfolio 1.154 GWp, growing as projects complete.
Standalone EPC margin improved; consolidated margin dip due to lower-margin T&D consolidation.
Working capital cycle around 60–90 days on progressive payments.
Group entities account for 30–40% of order book; management declined to clarify nature, directing to IR.
T&D execution timeline 18–24 months, longer than solar EPC.
BESS order book ₹200 Cr, margin in line with overall company margin.
Data centre EPC: no orders yet, building capability and in discussions.
The unexecuted order book stood at 2.83 gigawatt peak at the end of FY26.

guidance.statement: Management aims to maintain consolidated EBITDA margin around 15% for FY27, without formal guidance.

operating_notes.text: Waaree Renewable signed a turnkey EPC contract for a 350MW/1400MWh grid-connected BESS with two years of O&M, awarded by Waaree Forever Energies Private Limited, a subsidiary of its holding company, scheduled for completion in FY2026-27.

Waaree Renewable signed an LOA for EPC of a 300MW/450MWp ground-mount solar project plus two years of O&M from Sunsational Power Private Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary, scheduled for completion in FY2026-27; no rupee value disclosed.
Executed 888.81 MWp of projects in Q1FY27; O&M portfolio stood at 1.154 GWp.
Unexecuted order book of ₹5,300 Cr includes ₹200 Cr of BESS EPC and is to be executed over 12–15 months.
IPP portfolio of 82 MWp operational with a 198 MWp pipeline of small projects.
Scope under an existing 150 MWac/217.5 MWp ground-mount solar EPC order enhanced by approximately ₹22 Cr (excl. taxes), with all other terms unchanged.
Scope of existing solar EPC LoAs revised to an aggregate 800 MWac / 1,109 MWp, scheduled for execution in FY2027-28.

timeline.summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,102.40 Cr and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹3,331.42 Cr, with 2.7 GW of project execution.
Waaree Renewable Technologies executed definitive agreements to acquire a 55% stake in Associated Power Structures Private Limited for ₹1,225 Cr.

On 18 May 2026, Waaree Renewable Technologies signed a turnkey EPC contract for a 350MW/1400MWh grid-connected BESS with two years of O&M for Waaree Forever Energies Private Limited, a related party, to be completed in FY2026-27.

On 8 June 2026, Waaree Renewable Technologies signed an LOA for EPC of a 300MW/450MWp ground-mount solar project with two years of O&M from its wholly-owned subsidiary Sunsational Power Private Limited, to be completed in FY2026-27.

On 23 July 2026, Waaree Renewable Technologies held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹924.25 Cr (+53.23% YoY), PAT of ₹118.97 Cr (+37.7% YoY), an unexecuted order book of ₹5,300 Cr, and the completed acquisition of a 55% stake in Associated Power Structures.
On 15 October 2026, Waaree Renewable Technologies received a ₹22 Cr scope addition on an existing 150 MWac/217.5 MWp solar EPC order to be completed in FY2026-27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,057.84 Cr (+36.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹73.89 Cr (-36.5% YoY).
Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call for Q2FY27 and H1FY27 on October 21, 2026, hosted by Heema Shah, ACS.
Waaree Renewable Technologies updated earlier solar PV plant EPC LoAs, taking aggregate capacity to 800 MWac / 1,109 MWp for execution in FY2027-28.
